- **Relationship:** Marc's other Assistant Manager; owns **Sales & Service** — the sales floor, front-end,
  customer experience, Summit Rewards sign-ups, and scheduling.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, **Wednesday 8:30 AM** (right after Jordan Alvarez); runs the closing shift most days.
- **Owns:** the [Holiday Hiring Push](../projects/holiday-hiring-push.md) (with HR) and associate onboarding;
  also the associate-facing side of the [Horizon POS training](../projects/pos-loyalty-rollout.md).
- **Strengths:** high-energy, great with customers and new hires, the team's morale anchor. Best closer of

- **Watch-outs:** says yes to everything and over-commits; Marc has to help her prioritize. Take-rate on

  Foster's checklists.
